name: multitq_g1_ablation_rule
status: POST-HOC and DESCRIPTIVE. Registered after every k% test number exists (KP1-KP4 already decided). No pass/fail threshold is registered: the analysis reports estimates with CIs only. It cannot change any k% decision, label or primary-arm declaration.
question: How much does the frozen G_1 reasoner (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct LoRA, k = 1%, subset seed 0, ordS ep2) rely, at inference time, on each component of its structural guidance bundle (provenance facts, candidate list, ranker outputs, parse/trace), and how much on the quality of the facts (structural provenance vs GU dense-retrieved), on MultiTQ dev?
limitation_registered: The adapter was trained on full bundles only. Inference-time ablation measures how much the frozen model relies on each component, not the value of training without that component.

Every variant except A_full is out of the training format (sections are missing or reformatted). A drop therefore mixes information loss with format shift; the two cannot be separated with a frozen adapter.
G_HEAD is unchanged in every variant and still says that a pipeline parsed the question and ranked candidates.

The structural facts are SELECTED from S seed-0 provenance (support facts of the top candidates), so 'facts only' still carries the structural pipeline's retrieval and ranking through which facts are shown. A_facts / A_facts_cand remove the ORDER channel (seeded shuffle); A_facts_ord keeps the frozen order to measure it.

A_GUfacts changes the facts and, necessarily, the candidate-to-fact links (recomputed by string match); it measures the joint effect of the fact source and link definition with everything else held fixed.

Design knowledge: the structural pipeline, prompts and operators were designed with full-data development knowledge . The D_main pool excludes the two dev subsets on record as used (dev_sel2000, dev_sel10k), but earlier unrecorded use of dev cannot be excluded.

frozen_inputs.base_model: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (bf16, HF cache on the GPU host, HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1)
frozen_inputs.decoding: vLLM 0.10.2 (image tkgqa-vllm:latest), greedy (temperature 0, seed 0), max 48 new tokens, max_model_len 2304, gpu_memory_utilization 0.85, enable_lora max_lora_rank 16; 2,048-token prompt+answer cap with trailing displayed fact groups dropped (gk_common.fit_g_prompt rule); validity = gk_common.canon_answer (KG entity after normalisation, or a time string 2005-2015)
frozen_inputs.structural_executor: WORK_DIR/executor (kpct_core.py, models/k01_s0/{S_seed0-2.txt, parser.pt, linker.json, FB.json}); bundle recipe = robustness/code/rob_build.py (= kpct_run.stage_infer for kind 'test'), applied to dev question text only

dev_sets.why_not_full_dev: Frozen k01_s0 bundles exist only for dev_sel2000. Full dev (57,979) x 6 variants is projected at ~3.9 GPU-h before overhead (prompt-token estimate below), which leaves no margin under the 4 GPU-h cap; and dev_sel2000 / dev_sel10k were used for selection. So the main set is a GPU-hour cap-limited stratified prefix of the unused dev questions.

dev_sel2000.role: secondary set and A_full sanity check (same quids as the frozen 0.7990). It selected G_1's checkpoint and the structural S early stopping, so levels on it are optimistic; contrasts are reported but D_main is the main set.

D_main.pool: dev quids not in dev_sel2000 and not in dev_sel10k
D_main.registered_order: qtype-stratified interleaved permutation: for each qtype (sorted), members in ascending quid, p = default_rng(20261028).permutation(n_s), u = rng.random(n_s) (same rng, strata in sorted order); member p[pos] gets key (pos + u[pos]) / n_s; global order by (key, quid). Every prefix is proportionally stratified (max share deviation 0.0001 at 5,000).
D_main.blocks: consecutive blocks of 2,000 quids in the registered order (23 full blocks + 1 of 327)
D_main.evaluated_set: the longest prefix of whole blocks completed within the GPU-hour cap stop rule; its list sha256 is recorded in the results
D_main.bundles: rebuilt with the frozen k01_s0 executor from question text only (no answer read), identity-gated on dev_sel2000 (stop rule S2)
D_main.GU_facts: recomputed with the frozen GU retriever (gu_retrieve.py --mode queries), identity-gated on dev_sel2000 (stop rule S3)
D_main.S_seed0_tail: the executor's S seed-0 top-50 list for each rebuilt question

variants.A_full: frozen bundle, frozen rendering (gk_common.g_user(b, 'S')); prompt token ids asserted identical to gk_common.fit_g_prompt
variants.A_no_trace: A_full minus the 'Parse:' section and the 'Operator trace:' line. Candidate table (S order, RULE rank, S score, satisfies-operator flag, fact links) and facts (frozen order) unchanged. The per-candidate satisfies-operator flag is kept as a candidate-table column.
variants.A_facts_cand: structural facts (fact groups in the seeded random order default_rng([20261028, int(quid)]).permutation(n_groups), renumbered F1..) + 'Candidates:' list of candidate strings only (no RULE rank, S score, operator flag or fact links), in the k% rule's registered random order default_rng(int(quid)).permutation(n_cands) (the order G_1 ordrandom was trained with); no parse, no trace
variants.A_facts: structural facts only, fact groups in the same seeded random order as A_facts_cand; no candidates, parse or trace
variants.A_GUfacts: IN (GPU-hour cap allows). A_full format with the structural facts replaced by the first n GU dense-retrieved facts (n = the bundle's number of structural facts, 'same count'), grouped by (subject, relation, object) as in g_user in retrieval order; candidate fact links recomputed by string match (entity candidate = subject or object of the group; time candidate = a group date starting with it), at most 3 groups, ascending; parse, candidates (S order, ranks, scores, operator flag) and trace kept
variants.A_facts_ord: SUPPLEMENTARY (added by this rule, not in the analysts' list): structural facts only in the frozen order (S seed-0 provenance order). Justification: the frozen fact order follows the S seed-0 ranking, so A_facts_ord - A_facts measures the rank information carried by fact order alone.
variants.section_removal: removed components are omitted together with their section heading; remaining sections keep frozen wording and order; G_HEAD unchanged
variants.processing: all variants of a block are generated in one vLLM call (one session, one card, one adapter)

metrics.Hits@1, Hits@10: official scorer; ranked list for every variant = [answer] + S_k seed-0 list, deduplicated (the registered G construction). Hits@10 therefore differs between variants only through rank 1 (disclosed).
metrics.invalid_rate: share of outputs that are not a KG entity or valid time string after canonicalisation
metrics.answer_outside_candidates: share of rank-1 answers not among the bundle's top-20 structural candidates (exact string), for every variant including those that do not show candidates
metrics.answer_outside_shown_facts: share of rank-1 answers not found in the displayed facts (entity = subject/object; time = a displayed date with the answer as prefix)
metrics.gold_coverage_shown_facts: share of questions whose displayed facts (after truncation) contain an accepted gold string (gu_target semantics: entity = subject/object; time = a fact date truncated to the gold granularity)
metrics.gold_coverage_candidates: share of questions with a gold hit among the bundle's top-20 candidates (same for every variant; reported once)
metrics.truncation_rate: share of prompts with at least one fact group dropped by the 2,048-token cap
metrics.copy_S0: share of rank-1 answers equal to S seed-0's rank-1 answer; fixes (S0 miss, variant hit), losses (S0 hit, variant miss), net
metrics.strata: Hits@1 per qtype and per answer type (descriptive)

contrasts.primary_descriptive: each variant minus A_full, Hits@1, per set
chain_descriptive: A_no_trace - A_facts_cand (ranker outputs: S order, ranks, scores, operator flags, links; and fact order)
A_full - A_GUfacts (structural vs GU facts within the full format)
contrasts.statistic: paired Poisson(1) bootstrap over questions, B = 2000, seed 0, two-sided 95% percentile CI (tkg-claims-protocol paired_poisson_bootstrap; the weights depend only on n and the seed, as in the k% rule); strata B = 1000. No multiplicity correction and no p-value-based claim: every number is descriptive.

existing_prediction_analysis.inputs: frozen G_1 predictions pred_G_{dev_sel2000,test}_ordS_ep2.jsonl (test sha256 f5a132e4f5683371505ef316019e0d2a09229a411d6035f0f701a2c70af047ad), S_1 seed-0 lists preds/k01_s0/{dev_sel2000,test}_S_seed0.jsonl (test sha256 e3f7ec49cf37273115c311fbc233eb4a4675c2f80a2bc4bbf215d9389bc4c208), frozen k01_s0 bundles (test sha256 c9f18dc2ab090d8eb04c841592ea93befd3c1bf2e6a86279683851940ad57ca6), gu_test.jsonl.gz, official answers
existing_prediction_analysis.test_status: descriptive analysis of test predictions already scored once in the analysts' single k% pass; no new test prediction, no new variant on test

definitions.fixes: S0 Hits@1 miss and G_1 hit
definitions.fix_in_top20: fixes whose G_1 answer is in S0's top-20 (two readings reported: the S0 ranked list's first 20 entries incl. padding, and the bundle's 20 candidates)

existing_prediction_analysis.reconciliation: reproduce each reference numbers; any difference is explained by definition (string vs hit equality, top-20 reading, coverage semantics)

stop_rules.S1: adapter sha256 mismatch -> STOP, no output
stop_rules.S2: rebuilt dev_sel2000 bundles (executor, question text only) must render byte-identical user turns to the frozen bundles for >= 0.999 of questions in every non-GU variant, and identical S seed-0 lists for >= 0.999; else D_main is NOT_RUN (dev_sel2000 results only)
stop_rules.S3: recomputed GU top-20 for dev_sel2000 must equal the frozen gu_dev_sel2000 fact_ids (ordered) for >= 0.99 of questions; else A_GUfacts is NOT_RUN on D_main (dev_sel2000 keeps the frozen GU facts)
stop_rules.S4: A_full on dev_sel2000 must reproduce the frozen G_1: rank-1 agreement with pred_G_dev_sel2000_ordS_ep2 >= 0.99 and |Hits@1 - 0.7990| <= 0.005; else STOP before D_main (batch-composition nondeterminism of vLLM greedy decoding is the only accepted source of difference)
stop_rules.S5: A_full invalid rate on the first D_main block > 0.02 -> STOP
stop_rules.S6: before each D_main block: continue only if usage log GPU-h of track ablation_g1 so far + elapsed GPU-h of the running container + projected cost of the next block (mean of completed blocks; first block from the dev_sel2000 rate) + 0.10 <= 4.0
stop_rules.S7: yield: if the file WORK_DIR/ablation_g1/YIELD exists (the robustness track or the analysts may create it), stop after the current block; a later session resumes with the next block of the registered order (blocks are deterministic and the analysis uses whole completed blocks)
stop_rules.S8: no free card -> no dispatch; wait and re-check every 10 minutes

outputs: multitq_g1_ablation_bundles_manifest.json (sha256 of every rebuilt bundle / S list / GU file, identity checks)
chronology: Registered before any ablation bundle, retrieval or generation exists. Inputs seen before registration: the frozen dev_sel2000 bundles and GU facts (variant renderers tested on them, prompt lengths measured; gold coverage of structural vs GU facts on dev_sel2000 computed as a renderer check: 0.8955 vs 0.733), the reference test numbers, and no ablation output.
